title: intersection between polygons results in Point instead of Polygon
body: The intersection of a valid polygon (geom_0) with another valid polygon (zone) that should result in a Polygon results in a Point. Applying normalize or a different orientation on one of the polygons sometimes changes the result. When coordinates of geom_0 are slightly changed (1e-14) to (=geom_1), the result is correct as well. Originally reported here: https://github.com/shapely/shapely/issues/1639 Visualisation of the input polygons (zone: blue, geom_0: red, geom_1: green): Reproduction script: ``` python import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from shapely import normalize, orient_polygons, plotting, wkt zone = wkt.loads("POLYGON ((79.57006468414316 227.16715306136757, 43.44048377114246 -7.28462320799008, 127.74283932445364 -13.587090929970145, 154.99848808655608 219.60419326741248, 79.57006468414316 227.16715306136757))") geom_0 = wkt.loads("POLYGON ((127.74283932445364 -13.587090929970145, 43.44048377114247 -7.28462320799008, 54.329847263553376 63.37854389007508, 54.61818554266568 63.33040101339976, 135.62637080265046 53.862076963892896, 127.74283932445364 -13.587090929970145))") # this geometry is almost exactly the same as geom_0 geom_1 = wkt.loads("POLYGON ((127.74283932445363 -13.587091019377114, 43.44048377114246 -7.284623297862709, 54.32984726350768 63.37854379976558, 54.61818554261504 63.33040092309082, 135.62637080259915 53.862076873508386, 127.74283932445363 -13.587091019377114))") print(f"{zone.is_valid=}, {geom_0.is_valid=}, {geom_1.is_valid=}") # intersection of geom_0 with zone, gives a point, also if geom_0 is oriented cw print(f"Wrong: {geom_0.intersection(zone).geom_type=}") print(f"Wrong: {orient_polygons(geom_0, exterior_cw=True).intersection(zone).geom_type=}") # when geom_0 is oriented ccw or normalized first, gives a polygon print(f"OK: {orient_polygons(geom_0).intersection(zone).geom_type=}") print(f"OK: {normalize(geom_0).intersection(zone).geom_type=}") # intersection of zone with geom_0, gives a point too, also if zone is oriented ccw print(f"Wrong: {zone.intersection(geom_0).geom_type=}") print(f"Wrong: {orient_polygons(zone).intersection(geom_0).geom_type=}") # when zone is oriented cw or normalized first, gives a polygon print(f"OK: {orient_polygons(zone, exterior_cw=True).intersection(geom_0).geom_type=}") print(f"OK: {normalize(zone).intersection(geom_0).geom_type=}") # intersection of geom_1 with zone, gives a polygon print(f"OK: {geom_1.intersection(zone).geom_type=}") # Visualization fig, ax = plt.subplots(ncols=3, sharey=True) plotting.plot_polygon(zone, ax=ax[0], color="blue", alpha=0.3) plotting.plot_polygon(zone, ax=ax[1], color="blue", alpha=0.3) plotting.plot_polygon(geom_0, ax=ax[1], color="red", alpha=0.3) plotting.plot_polygon(zone, ax=ax[2], color="blue", alpha=0.3) plotting.plot_polygon(geom_1, ax=ax[2], color="green", alpha=0.3) plt.show() ``` Output: ``` zone.is_valid=True, geom_0.is_valid=True, geom_1.is_valid=True Wrong: geom_0.intersection(zone).geom_type='Point' Wrong: orient_polygons(geom_0, exterior_cw=True).intersection(zone).geom_type='Point' OK: orient_polygons(geom_0).intersection(zone).geom_type='Polygon' OK: normalize(geom_0).intersection(zone).geom_type='Polygon' Wrong: zone.intersection(geom_0).geom_type='Point' Wrong: orient_polygons(zone).intersection(geom_0).geom_type='Point' OK: orient_polygons(zone, exterior_cw=True).intersection(geom_0).geom_type='Polygon' OK: normalize(zone).intersection(geom_0).geom_type='Polygon' OK: geom_1.intersection(zone).geom_type='Polygon' ```
